Bilopillia Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Most of Bilopillya's Jews apparently succeeded in leaving before German forces arrived in the second half of July 1941 — a notably successful evacuation compared to many communities in this collection — though local Ukrainians staged a pogrom soon after the occupation began, killing at least one Jew who remained. About 70 more were murdered by German and Ukrainian auxiliary police in May 1942, and the last 24 Jews still in the town were sent to forced labor by the end of that year.
